description: For a customer who signed in to the account connector with the email they booked with: their own bookings from the last 90 days and upcoming, each with its status, time, price, what to do next and its private link for the other booking tools. Takes no arguments. Without sign-in it explains how to connect; use request_status with the person's private link instead.
name: my_bookings
title: My bookings (signed-in customer)
